report.title: Ba da rahoton matsala
report.intro: Masu tallafi za su sami abin da ake yi da tsawon lokacin da kowane mataki ya ɗauka, sigar, burauzarka da saitunanka. Babu ɗaya daga cikin kalmominka, fayilolinka, sunaye ko makullanka da ke tafiya tare da shi.
report.wordsHint: Sai idan masu tallafi suna buƙatar su don ganin abin da ya lalace.
report.json: Duka, yadda masu tallafi ke karanta shi
report.link: Ƙirƙiri hanyar haɗi don masu tallafi
report.written: An kwafi rahoton: liƙa shi a cikin saƙonka.
report.linked: An kwafi hanyar haɗin. Za ta daina aiki bayan mako guda, kuma za ka iya dakatar da ita kafin hakan daga cikin hanyoyin haɗinka.
report.refused: Dokokin ƙungiyarka sun ajiye wannan rahoton a wannan na'urar.
report.failed: Hakan bai yi aiki ba. Sake gwadawa, ko ajiye shi a matsayin fayil.
report.subject: {name} {version}: matsala
report.mailBody: Rahoton yana kan allon kwafinka: liƙa shi a nan.
report.stage.read: Ana karanta fayilolin da ka raba
report.unsent.held: Ba a aika ba: buƙatarka ta ƙarshe har yanzu ana kanta.
report.unsent.unreached: Ba a aika ba: buƙatarka ba ta isa ba.
report.unsent.loading: Ba a aika ba: abin da ke aika shi har yanzu yana lodawa.
report.unsent.unloaded: Ba a aika ba: abin da ke aika shi bai loda ba.
report.takeIntro: Rahoton da wani ya aiko maka zai zama kwafin maye: tsari iri ɗaya, da kalmomin cike gurbi masu tsawo iri ɗaya, don maidowa a cikin sabon bayanin martaba.
report.paste: Liƙa rahoton, ko shafin da hanyar haɗinsa ke nunawa
report.standInSaved: An ajiye. Maido da shi a cikin sabon bayanin martaba, daga Bayananka. Babu a ciki: {missing}.
report.missing.files: fayiloli da manyan fayiloli da aka raba
report.missing.routines: ƙare-ƙare, ayyukan lokaci-lokaci da ƙwarewar da ke a shirye
report.missing.own: ayyuka da adiresoshin mai aikawa na kansa
report.missing.device: zaɓuɓɓukan wannan na'urar na kanta, kamar iyakar wata
